newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - TOP JAPAN BUSINESS NEWS - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TOP JAPAN BUSINESS NEWS - AUG 13.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- DVD-RAM makers in Japan, the United States and Europe divided over standardisation.
-- Management and Coordination Agency Minister Kabun Muto proposes setting up new agency to handle three postal operations.
-- Posts and Telecommunications Ministry to cut number of door-to-door sellers of postal savings accounts and insurance by about 8,000 over 10-year period.
-- Growth of world trade sharply decelerated in calendar 1996.
-- Osaka and Yokohama face-off in bid to become Japanese candidate for 2008 Summer Olympics.
